Government Meera Girls College Udaipur

Government Meera Girls’ College, Udaipur esteemed as the first and the largest post graduate college for women in the Udaipur region of Rajasthan State is fortuitous to be situated in the picturesque tourist destination city of Lakes, Government Meera Girls College, Udaipur is the biggest and top-ranking Post-Graduate women’s college in south Rajasthan.

The college is named after “MEERA” who had renounced the luxurious royal life and adopted sainthood in her avowed devotion for Lord Krishna; thus symbolic of educative values of dedication, devotion and sincerity for attainment of life-goals.
